changes.before:
A new user terminal was installed at an isolated research station. Arrange the satellite communications network elements and define their connections to each other. The team needs to get the station online via the satellite infrastructure for the first time. To do this, the role of each element must be determined and the signal route must be set up correctly.
After the route is assembled, the system will check the connection. If all devices are arranged in the correct sequence, the signal will pass from the terminal through the satellite and the ground station to the data processing center, and the station will receive stable internet access.

Mission: Determine the correct sequence of network elements and initiate the signal.
